idea.value: A business bank that keeps the standing of an old institution but moves money at the speed of digital dollars, anywhere: shown as one object (the payment card) that grows out of the idea, then proved in the real interface, on a map of cities and in a phone wallet.
evidence: speech-text.json 4.017 s thesis line; 14.017 s promise line; 22.5–25.5 s journey line

audience.value: Owners and finance leads of small and mid-size businesses that pay or get paid across borders and are curious about stablecoins.
evidence: speech-text.json: card tier name 'Infinite Business' (8.5–13.5 s); account names 'AP/OPS', 'Checking' (21.0–22.5 s); sidebar items Invoices, Reimbursement, Team, Capital (18.5–19.5 s)

value.description: 0.0–1.97 s: a low-angle classical bank facade with national flags, the wordmark revealed over it — the old institution. At 1.67 s a dark green sheet rises over it and a single line builds word by word to state the twist: the old meets the new money. The viewer's first question is how the two fit, and the next shot answers with a product object grown from that very line.

value.content: Bank facade with flags; wordmark reveal.

value.retentionDevice: line completes one word at a time
value.content: Dark green ground, ring figure, thesis line, three currency chips.

value.purpose: Product object grows out of the idea
value.retentionDevice: uncut chain of transformations: frame → slab → button → object
value.content: Frame shrinks to a slab, button types 'create' action, flips into the metal card, card fans and orbits.

value.retentionDevice: line builds over a dramatic sky
value.content: Storm clouds, promise line about speed.

value.retentionDevice: panels assembling, then a camera that keeps moving
value.content: Product list panels grow, pull-back to the whole dashboard, tilt; cut to a transfer form.

value.retentionDevice: 4-frame flash cuts under a completing sentence
value.content: Origin city aerial, five destination flashes, landing city.

value.retentionDevice: device rises into frame, confirmation tick
value.content: Phone wallet paying with the card; headline about spending digital dollars.

value.purpose: Anthem: values, ending on the viewer
value.retentionDevice: repeated lead phrase, one new word per 1 s plate
value.content: Two negations (borders, delays), four affirmations (speed, ambition, owners, you).

value.retentionDevice: bookend wordmark move from the opening
value.content: Wordmark on white, small CTA line.

payoff.value: The anthem turns from the product to the viewer: the last value word is the second person, alone on white and in the brand green, and the wordmark from the first second returns with the same reveal.

callToAction.value: A small line under the wordmark inviting the viewer to go international with the brand; no URL, no button.

whyItWorks: The opening image is the category's old symbol, so the thesis line reads as a correction of it in under 6 s, without voice.
The product object is born from the thesis frame itself (frame → slab → button → object, 5.4–8.7 s, no cut), so the eye never has to search for the new subject.
Claims are followed by visible proof in the order a buyer would check: the real interface, a real transfer form, real places, a phone payment.
Speed is shown by the edit itself: five 4-frame plates under one sentence.
The film slows into long built transitions in its first half and speeds into hard cuts in the second, so energy rises toward the anthem.
Restraint holds it together: three grounds (dark green, warm off-white, white), one light sans, one italic serif, one accent green.
